item.title: Nike faces federal probe over allegations of ‘DEI-related’ discrimination against white workers
item.description: Nike called the subpoena a surprising escalation.

item.title: CIA ends publication of its popular World Factbook reference tool
item.description: The agency announced the decision Wednesday but gave no reason for it.

item.title: Chris Pratt and Jon Bon Jovi to introduce teams at Super Bowl LX
item.description: The celebrities will be getting the crowd at Levi's Stadium pumped as the Seattle Seahawks and the New England Patriots hit the field.

item.title: New York Jets hire ex-Stanford interim coach Frank Reich as offensive coordinator
item.description: Reich spent last year as Stanford’s interim head coach, replacing Troy Taylor, and led the Cardinal to their most victories since 2020.

item.title: Marin set to receive $5.6M in federal earmarks
item.description: The funding requested by Rep. Jared Huffman will support projects involving affordable housing, water supply and child care.

item.title: Sports Briefs: St. Vincent football stars Ellis, Chaput, Cassanovas commit
item.description: Novato residents Jack Ellis, George Chaput and Gabe Cassanovas joined the signing day ceremonies at St. Vincent de Paul School in Petaluma on Wednesday as they announced the next step in their football careers.

item.title: Boys soccer: Tam secures MCAL’s top seed after seven-goal thriller
item.description: The players on the Tam High boys soccer team took to its home field on Wednesday knowing that a win over the defending MCAL regular-season champions would allow them to claim the title for themselves.

item.title: Warriors trade Jonathan Kuminga to Hawks on eve of deadline
item.description: Golden State gets Kristaps Porzingis in deal for Kuminga and Buddy Hield.

item.title: Askarov shines, but late goal dooms Sharks in loss to Avalanche
item.description: Avalanche defenseman Josh Manson scores winning goal with 7:16 left in regulation time

item.title: How Kristaps Porzingis fits with Warriors after Kuminga trade
item.description: Kristaps Porzingis is a knockdown shooter and intimidating rim protector … when he is healthy
